text:
alex: Repro report: streaming fncall + retry path collapses chunk boundaries and causes our JSON helper to throw.

alex: Setup: python samplekit v0.11, streaming=true, json_mode=true, schema = oneOf [object, array]. Server sends two ndjson chunks, then responds 429 on ack which triggers client retry.

alex: Good stream (no retry):
{"a":1}
---chunk---
{"a":2}

alex: After retry the retrier buffers and replays as: {"a":1}{"a":2} (single payload). Our helper tries JSON.parse on whole payload and fails.

priya: Looks like the buffering code merges byte chunks when reconstructing the request body for replay. We should preserve the original chunk boundaries or mark it as ndjson.

toni: Short-term workaround for customers: set streaming:false or use schema that expects an array. Longer term we need two changes: 1) retrier must preserve raw-chunk framing, 2) streaming parser should fall back to ndjson-splitting when parse fails.

qa: I have a minimal mock server to reproduce; I'll attach to the issue. Steps: start mock to send two chunks then 429, run client with retries enabled, verify combined chunk on replay.

alex: Filing issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/issues/458 (includes mock harness and logs).

toni: I'll own the parser change (ndjson fallback + tests). Approach: on parse error, try to split by /}
{/ and parse each segment as a JSON value; wrap results into array if multiple.

priya: I'll update the retrier to keep an array of raw chunk buffers instead of concatenating, and re-send them with original boundaries. If preserving boundaries isn't viable, we'll tag the Content-Type and send as chunked ndjson.

build-bot: CI queued for branches/streaming-retry-fix-458.

qa: ETA: retrier PR by EOD today, parser PR by tomorrow. I'll add integration tests that simulate collapsed boundaries to catch regressions.

alex: Thanks folks, customer is blocked on streaming onboarding. I'll update them once we have the PRs.
